calculation.description: Twenty-session momentum weighted by ten-session directional efficiency. Persistent one-directional paths retain momentum exposure, while choppy paths are attenuated. Uses only information available at the completed signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.036841, 754 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.028612, 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.016607, 574 dates). Cross-sectional observations used at least 8 of 15 tradable instruments; uncertainty remains material due to the small universe.
